description: A GitHub-compatible forge in Go: REST v3, GraphQL, MCP and git smart HTTP on one in-memory store, shipped as a prebuilt static binary launched from main.ts
name: github-core-clone-01-v3

scripts.build: cd go && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../forge-linux-amd64 . && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -o ../forge-linux-arm64 .
